in_marathi.name: Vashishth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vashishth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vashishth means 'wise, intelligent' and is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vashat', which means 'to shine'. This name is often given to boys in India, particularly in Hindu families, as a sign of wisdom and intelligence.
